blind.B1: No exercise intervention or arm. Cross-sectional ageing study: young (19-25/27 y, n=20) vs older (65-71 y, n=18) males matched for physical activity (S2.2.p1, Table 1). Only exercise-related analysis is an association of expression with continuous accelerometer MVPA (S3.4.p4). No sample carries an exercise factor in GEO metadata.
blind.B2: Older vs Young, DESeq2, 18 vs 20 (S2.5.p2, S3.1.p1). Within-group MVPA association (limma-voom) in older and young.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one vastus lateralis biopsy per subject; packet A keys link 0/38.
blind.B4: Paper fits DESeq2 on the two age groups; limma-voom with MVPA continuous within each age group. No multi-group model.
blind.B5: Genes with <10 reads per row removed; Benjamini-Hochberg, FDR 5% (S2.5.p2); no fold-change cutoff. 4327 DEGs (adj P<0.05), 3797 coding, 1891 up / 1906 down in older (S3.1.p1); MVPA association at unadjusted P<0.05 (662 older, 1058 young).

checks.evidence: S2.2.p1, S1.p3: groups matched for activity; no exercise arm; GEO columns only age group
No contrast run; Young 20/Older 18 matches Table 1
One biopsy per subject; packet A keys link 0/38
Single sex; no batch field; not run
Integer HTSeq counts, integer_fraction 1.0, max 2.06M; DESeq2 recommended, matches S2.5.p1
Recorded BH FDR 0.05, no FC cutoff, <10 reads filter, matches S2.5.p2
HANDBACK makes no ours-vs-paper claim; paper counts correctly attributed

Claim 'no exercise arm' and 'MVPA absent from metadata' hold: per-sample columns are only title, geo_accession, relation, supplementary file; wide search of exercise words found only the biopsy protocol

human_items: Policy: Older vs Young under matched activity is executable (suitability analyzable) but is an ageing estimand; refusal as an exercise study follows the skill's rule, but a person may want it recorded as non-exercise rather than refused.
summary: 该研究是活动量匹配的老年vs青年横断面比较,没有运动干预组,GEO元数据也没有个体MVPA,因此在design阶段拒绝运行是正确的。停止理由经论文和元数据核对成立,阈值、矩阵类型和配对判断均无异议。
